blocks.html:
New filter promises clean water for millions

An ingenious invention is set to bring clean water to developing countries, and while the science may be cutting edge, the materials are extremely down to earth.

A handful of clay, yesterday's coffee grounds and some cow manure are the ingredients that could bring clean, safe drinking water to many developing countries. The simple new technology, developed by Australian National University (ANU) materials scientist and potter Tony Flynn, allows water filters to be made from commonly available materials and fired (or baked) using cow manure as the source of heat, without the need for a kiln (an oven for baking or drying pottery). The filters have been tested and shown to remove common pathogens (disease-producing organisms) including E. coli.

The invention was born out of a project involving the Manatuto community in East Timor. A charity operating there wanted to help set up a small industrial site manufacturing water filters, but initial research found the local clay to be too fine — a problem solved by the addition of organic material. While the problems of producing a working ceramic filter in East Timor were overcome, the solution was kiln-based and particular to that community's materials and couldn't be applied elsewhere. Flynn's technique for manure firing, with no requirement for a kiln, has made this zero-technology approach available anywhere it is needed.

Other commercial clay filters do exist, but, even if available, with prices starting at US$5 each, they are often outside the budgets of most people in the developing world. Unlike other water filtering devices, Flynn's filters are inexpensive and simple to produce. Take a handful of clay, mix it with a handful of organic material such as used tea leaves, coffee grounds or rice hulls, add water in a sufficient quantity to make a stiff mixture and form a cylindrical pot that has one end closed, then dry it in the sun. According to Flynn, used coffee grounds have given the best results to date. The walls of the filter can be measured using the width of an adult finger as the standard. Next, surround the pots with straw, put them in a mound of cow manure, light the straw and then top up the burning manure as required. The filters are finished in 45 to 60 minutes.

The properties of cow manure are vital, as the fuel can reach a temperature of 700 degrees in half an hour, and will be up to 950 degrees after another 20 to 30 minutes. The manure makes a good fuel because it is very high in organic material that burns readily and quickly. The manure has to be dry and is best used exactly as found in the field; there is no need to break it up or process it any further. In contrast, a potter's kiln is an expensive item and can take up to four or five hours to get up to 800 degrees. It needs expensive, scarce fuel, such as gas or wood to heat it, and experience to use it. With no technology, no insulation and nothing other than a pile of cow manure and a match, none of these requirements apply.

It is also helpful that, like clay and organic material, cow manure is freely available across the developing world. A cow is a natural fuel factory. Manure is a mixture of vegetable materials of different sizes, and cow manure as a fuel is the same wherever it is found.

Just as using manure as a fuel for domestic use is not a new idea, the fact that liquid can pass through clay objects is something that potters have always known, and clay's porous nature is something that, as a former ceramics lecturer in the ANU School of Art, Flynn is well aware of. The difference is that, rather than viewing the porous nature of the material as a problem — after all, not many people want a pot that won't hold water — his filters capitalize on this property.

The filtration process is simple, but effective. The basic principle is that there are passages through the filter that are wide enough for water droplets to pass through, but too narrow for pathogens. Tests with the deadly E. coli bacterium have seen the filters remove 96.4 to 99.8 per cent of the pathogen — well within safe levels. The thickness of the clay container needs to be the same thickness as an adult finger for the process to be effective. If this is the case, using only one filter, a liter of water can be obtained in two hours.

The use of organic material, which burns away leaving cavities after firing, helps produce the structure in which pathogens will become trapped. It overcomes the potential problems of finer clays that may not let water through and also means that cracks are soon halted. And like clay and cow manure, organic material is universally available in the developing communities that need the most assistance, as tea, coffee and rice are grown in these areas.

With all the components being widely available, Flynn says there is no reason the technology couldn't be applied throughout the developing world. He has no plans to exploit his idea financially by registering ownership through a patent. If he did, any commercial copying would legally entitle him to a share in any profits made. Without a patent, there will be no illegality in it being adopted in any community that needs it. “Everyone has a right to clean water, and these filters have the potential to enable anyone in the world to drink water safely," says Flynn.

passageNotes.label: Paragraph 1
passageNotes.text: 一把黏土、昨天的咖啡渣和一些牛粪，这些材料可以为许多发展中国家带来干净、安全的饮用水。这项简单的新技术由澳大利亚国立大学（ANU）材料科学家兼陶艺家托尼·弗林（Tony Flynn）开发，它允许使用常见材料制作水过滤器，并以牛粪作为热源进行烧制（或烘烤），而无需窑炉（用于烧制或干燥陶器的烤箱）。这些过滤器经过测试，已被证明能够去除包括大肠杆菌在内的常见病原体（致病微生物）。

passageNotes.label: Paragraph 2
passageNotes.text: 这项发明源于一个涉及东帝汶马纳图托（Manatuto）社区的项目。在那里运营的一个慈善机构希望帮助建立一个小型工业场地来生产水过滤器，但初步研究发现当地的黏土过于细腻——这个问题通过添加有机材料得到了解决。虽然在东帝汶生产可用的陶瓷过滤器的问题得到了解决，但该方案依赖于窑炉，并且专门适用于该社区的材料，无法应用到其他地方。弗林的牛粪烧制技术不需要窑炉，使得这种零技术含量的方法可以在任何需要的地方使用。

passageNotes.label: Paragraph 3
passageNotes.text: 市面上确实存在其他商用黏土过滤器，但即使能够买到，每只5美元起的价格也往往超出了发展中国家大多数人的预算。与其他水过滤装置不同，弗林的过滤器价格低廉且制作简单。取一把黏土，与一把有机材料（如用过的茶叶、咖啡渣或稻壳）混合，加入适量的水使其成为硬质混合物，然后将其塑造成一端封闭的圆柱形罐子，再放在阳光下晒干。据弗林介绍，用过的咖啡渣迄今为止效果最好。过滤器的壁厚可以用成人手指的宽度作为标准来测量。接下来，用稻草包裹罐子，将其放入一堆牛粪中，点燃稻草，然后根据需要补充燃烧的牛粪。过滤器在45到60分钟内即可完成。

passageNotes.label: Paragraph 4
passageNotes.text: 牛粪的特性至关重要，因为这种燃料可以在半小时内达到700度的温度，再过20到30分钟后可达到950度。牛粪是一种很好的燃料，因为它含有非常高的有机物质，这些物质容易快速燃烧。牛粪必须是干燥的，最好直接使用在田野中收集到的原样；无需将其打碎或进行任何进一步加工。相比之下，陶艺家的窑炉是昂贵的设备，可能需要四到五个小时才能达到800度。它需要昂贵且稀缺的燃料（如天然气或木材）来加热，还需要经验才能使用。而使用牛粪不需要任何技术、任何隔热材料，除了一堆牛粪和一根火柴之外什么都不需要，上述所有要求都不适用。

passageNotes.label: Paragraph 5
passageNotes.text: 同样有帮助的是，与黏土和有机材料一样，牛粪在发展中国家各地都是可以自由获取的。一头牛就是一个天然的燃料工厂。牛粪是不同大小的植物材料的混合物，无论在何处发现，牛粪作为燃料的性质都是相同的。

passageNotes.label: Paragraph 6
passageNotes.text: 正如将牛粪用作家庭燃料并非新想法一样，液体可以穿透黏土制品这一事实也是陶艺家一直都知道的，而黏土的多孔性也是弗林作为澳大利亚国立大学艺术学院前陶瓷讲师所熟知的。区别在于，他没有将材料的多孔性视为一个问题——毕竟，没有多少人想要一个装不住水的罐子——而是利用了这一特性。

passageNotes.label: Paragraph 7
passageNotes.text: 过滤过程简单而有效。基本原理是，过滤器中有足够宽的通道让水滴通过，但又太窄而病原体无法通过。对致命的大肠杆菌进行的测试表明，过滤器能去除96.4%到99.8%的病原体——完全在安全水平之内。黏土容器的厚度需要与成人手指的厚度相同，过滤过程才能有效。如果满足这一条件，仅使用一个过滤器，两小时即可获得一升水。

passageNotes.label: Paragraph 8
passageNotes.text: 有机材料的使用——它们在烧制过程中燃烧殆尽后留下空腔——有助于形成病原体被困住的结构。它克服了较细黏土可能不透水的潜在问题，也意味着裂缝很快就会停止扩展。与黏土和牛粪一样，有机材料在最需要帮助的发展中社区也是普遍可获得的，因为茶叶、咖啡和水稻都种植在这些地区。

passageNotes.label: Paragraph 9
passageNotes.text: 由于所有材料都可以广泛获取，弗林表示没有理由不能将这项技术应用于整个发展中世界。他没有计划通过注册专利所有权来从经济上利用他的想法。如果他这样做，任何商业复制行为都将使他有权合法地分享所获得的利润。没有专利，任何需要它的社区采用这项技术都不会违法。“人人都有权获得干净的饮用水，这些过滤器有可能让世界上任何人都能安全地饮用饮用水，”弗林说。

items.text:
（1）题目 14：Make the mixture for the filter from organic material (e.g., tea, coffee, rice), ________ and ________.
题目翻译：第14题：制作滤器混合物时，有机材料之后的第一个空格应填哪种材料？
答案：clay
定位：第3段，制作混合物的步骤
原文：Take a handful of clay, mix it with a handful of organic material such as used tea leaves, coffee grounds or rice hulls, add water in a sufficient quantity to make a stiff mixture and form a cylindrical pot that has one end closed, then dry it in the sun.
译文：取一把黏土，与一把有机材料（如用过的茶叶、咖啡渣或稻壳）混合，再加入足量的水，制成硬挺的混合物；然后做成一端封闭的圆柱形陶器并在阳光下晾干。

解析：原文首先提到取一把 clay，再与有机材料混合并加水。organic material 已在题干中给出；第14题的第一个空格填写 clay，第15题另填 water。

（2）题目 15：Make the mixture for the filter from organic material (e.g., tea, coffee, rice), ________ and ________.
题目翻译：第15题：制作滤器混合物时，有机材料之后的第二个空格应填哪种材料？
答案：water
定位：第3段，制作混合物的步骤
原文：add water in a sufficient quantity to make a stiff mixture
译文：加入足量的水，制成硬挺的混合物。

解析：题干中材料列表的第二个空格对应原文 add water，填写 water。

（3）题目 16：Shape into pots and place them in a fire made from ________ and ________.
题目翻译：第16题：烧制陶器的两种材料中，第一个空格应填什么？
答案：straw
定位：第3段，点火步骤
原文：Next, surround the pots with straw, put them in a mound of cow manure, light the straw and then top up the burning manure as required.
译文：接着，用稻草把陶器围住，把它们放进一堆牛粪中，点燃稻草，并按需补充正在燃烧的牛粪。

解析：原文先说用 straw 围住陶器，再将其放入一堆 cow manure 中。第16题的第一个空格填写 straw，第17题另填 cow manure。

（4）题目 17：Shape into pots and place them in a fire made from ________ and ________.
题目翻译：第17题：烧制陶器的两种材料中，第二个空格应填什么？
答案：cow manure
定位：第3段，点火步骤
原文：put them in a mound of cow manure
译文：把陶器放进一堆牛粪中。

解析：用稻草围住陶器之后，原文要求将陶器放入一堆 cow manure 中；第17题的第二个空格填写 cow manure。

（5）题目 18：Fuel the fire to reach a maximum temperature of ________.
题目翻译：把火加热到的最高温度是多少？
答案：950 degrees
定位：第4段，首句
原文：The properties of cow manure are vital, as the fuel can reach a temperature of 700 degrees in half an hour, and will be up to 950 degrees after another 20 to 30 minutes.
译文：牛粪的特性至关重要：这种燃料半小时可达700度，再过20至30分钟可升至950度。

解析：原文先说半小时达到700度，再说继续20至30分钟后最高达到950度。题干问 maximum temperature，因此答案必须是完整的原文词组 950 degrees。

（6）题目 19：Bake the filters in the fire for a maximum period of ________.
题目翻译：滤器在火中烘烤的最长时间是多少？
答案：60 minutes
定位：第3段，末句
原文：The filters are finished in 45 to 60 minutes.
译文：这些滤器可在45至60分钟内烧制完成。

解析：原文给出的区间是45至60分钟；题干问 maximum period，所以取区间上限 60 minutes。

items.text:
（1）题目 20：The clay in the Manatuto project was initially unsuitable for the purpose of the project.
题目翻译：Manatuto 项目中的黏土起初不适合该项目的用途。
答案：TRUE
定位：第2段，第2句
原文：A charity operating there wanted to help set up a small industrial site manufacturing water filters, but initial research found the local clay to be too fine — a problem solved by the addition of organic material.
译文：一家在当地运作的慈善机构希望协助建立一个制造净水滤器的小型工业点，但初步研究发现当地黏土过细；加入有机材料解决了这个问题。

解析：原文说当地黏土起初“too fine”，并把它明确称为需要解决的问题，说明它当时不适合直接制造所需滤器。题干与原文一致，所以答案为 TRUE。

（2）题目 21：Coffee grounds produce filters that are twice as efficient as those using other organic materials.
题目翻译：咖啡渣制成的滤器效率是使用其他有机材料制成的滤器的两倍。
答案：NOT GIVEN
定位：第3段，第4句
原文：According to Flynn, used coffee grounds have given the best results to date.
译文：据弗林说，用过的咖啡渣迄今取得了最好的效果。

解析：原文只说咖啡渣“迄今效果最好”，没有给出效率数值，也没有说其效率是其他材料的两倍。“twice as efficient”无法由原文确认或否定，因此答案为 NOT GIVEN。

（3）题目 22：It takes half an hour for a cow manure fire to reach 950 degrees.
题目翻译：牛粪燃料只需半小时就能达到950度。
答案：FALSE
定位：第4段，首句
原文：The properties of cow manure are vital, as the fuel can reach a temperature of 700 degrees in half an hour, and will be up to 950 degrees after another 20 to 30 minutes.
译文：牛粪的特性至关重要：这种燃料半小时可达700度，再过20至30分钟可升至950度。

解析：原文说半小时只能达到700度；还需要再过20至30分钟才会达到950度。题干把950度的总加热过程缩短为半小时，与原文相反，所以答案为 FALSE。

（4）题目 23：E. coli is the most difficult bacterium to remove from water by filtration.
题目翻译：在过滤水时，大肠杆菌是最难去除的细菌。
答案：NOT GIVEN
定位：第1段，末句
原文：The filters have been tested and shown to remove common pathogens (disease-producing organisms) including E. coli.
译文：滤器经测试可去除常见病原体，其中包括大肠杆菌。
定位：第7段，第3句
原文：Tests with the deadly E. coli bacterium have seen the filters remove 96.4 to 99.8 per cent of the pathogen — well within safe levels.
译文：针对致命的大肠杆菌的测试显示，滤器能去除该病原体的96.4%至99.8%，达到安全水平。

解析：原文只说明滤器能去除大肠杆菌并给出去除比例，没有把它与其他细菌比较，也没有说它“最难去除”。该最高级信息缺失，因此答案为 NOT GIVEN。

questionExplanations.text:
（1）题目 20：The clay in the Manatuto project was initially unsuitable for the purpose of the project.
题目翻译：Manatuto 项目中的黏土起初不适合该项目的用途。
答案：TRUE
定位：第2段，第2句
原文：A charity operating there wanted to help set up a small industrial site manufacturing water filters, but initial research found the local clay to be too fine — a problem solved by the addition of organic material.
译文：一家在当地运作的慈善机构希望协助建立一个制造净水滤器的小型工业点，但初步研究发现当地黏土过细；加入有机材料解决了这个问题。

解析：原文说当地黏土起初“too fine”，并把它明确称为需要解决的问题，说明它当时不适合直接制造所需滤器。题干与原文一致，所以答案为 TRUE。

（2）题目 21：Coffee grounds produce filters that are twice as efficient as those using other organic materials.
题目翻译：咖啡渣制成的滤器效率是使用其他有机材料制成的滤器的两倍。
答案：NOT GIVEN
定位：第3段，第4句
原文：According to Flynn, used coffee grounds have given the best results to date.
译文：据弗林说，用过的咖啡渣迄今取得了最好的效果。

解析：原文只说咖啡渣“迄今效果最好”，没有给出效率数值，也没有说其效率是其他材料的两倍。“twice as efficient”无法由原文确认或否定，因此答案为 NOT GIVEN。

（3）题目 22：It takes half an hour for a cow manure fire to reach 950 degrees.
题目翻译：牛粪燃料只需半小时就能达到950度。
答案：FALSE
定位：第4段，首句
原文：The properties of cow manure are vital, as the fuel can reach a temperature of 700 degrees in half an hour, and will be up to 950 degrees after another 20 to 30 minutes.
译文：牛粪的特性至关重要：这种燃料半小时可达700度，再过20至30分钟可升至950度。

解析：原文说半小时只能达到700度；还需要再过20至30分钟才会达到950度。题干把950度的总加热过程缩短为半小时，与原文相反，所以答案为 FALSE。

（4）题目 23：E. coli is the most difficult bacterium to remove from water by filtration.
题目翻译：在过滤水时，大肠杆菌是最难去除的细菌。
答案：NOT GIVEN
定位：第1段，末句
原文：The filters have been tested and shown to remove common pathogens (disease-producing organisms) including E. coli.
译文：滤器经测试可去除常见病原体，其中包括大肠杆菌。
定位：第7段，第3句
原文：Tests with the deadly E. coli bacterium have seen the filters remove 96.4 to 99.8 per cent of the pathogen — well within safe levels.
译文：针对致命的大肠杆菌的测试显示，滤器能去除该病原体的96.4%至99.8%，达到安全水平。

解析：原文只说明滤器能去除大肠杆菌并给出去除比例，没有把它与其他细菌比较，也没有说它“最难去除”。该最高级信息缺失，因此答案为 NOT GIVEN。

items.text:
（1）题目 24：The Manatuto project aimed to set up a
题目翻译：Manatuto 项目的目标是建立什么？
答案：C（water filter factory.）
定位：第2段，第2句
原文：A charity operating there wanted to help set up a small industrial site manufacturing water filters
译文：一家在当地运作的慈善机构希望协助建立一个制造净水滤器的小型工业点。

解析：题干中的 set up a 对应原文的 set up a small industrial site，manufacturing water filters 说明该地点用于生产净水滤器，因此选 C。

（2）题目 25：To be effective, the Flynn filters must
题目翻译：要使 Flynn 滤器有效，它必须满足什么条件？
答案：B（be a particular thickness.）
定位：第7段，第4句
原文：The thickness of the clay container needs to be the same thickness as an adult finger for the process to be effective.
译文：要使过滤过程有效，黏土容器的厚度必须与成年人的手指厚度相同。

解析：原文用 needs to 和 for the process to be effective 直接给出必要条件：容器厚度要与成年人的手指相同，即必须达到特定厚度，因此选 B。

（3）题目 26：Flynn does not intend to patent his filter because he
题目翻译：Flynn 为什么不打算为他的滤器申请专利？
答案：A（wants it to be freely available.）
定位：第9段，第2句
原文：He has no plans to exploit his idea financially by registering ownership through a patent.
译文：他不打算通过申请专利来利用这一想法牟利。
定位：第9段，第4句
原文：Without a patent, there will be no illegality in it being adopted in any community that needs it.
译文：没有专利，任何有需要的社区采用这一技术都不违法。

解析：原文说他不想以专利牟利；没有专利，任何有需要的社区都可以合法采用这一技术。这说明他希望滤器自由可用，因此选 A。
